# Sophia Hair Braiding

> Hair braiding studio based in Austin, Texas. Boho knotless, box braids, feed-ins and miracle knots by Sophia in Montopolis. She takes her time, checks in after the first braid, and your head won't be sore when you leave.

- Phone: (737) 232-0234
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Montopolis, Riverside, Del Valle, Pleasant Valley, Onion Creek
- Google rating: 4.8 from 23 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/sophia-hair-braiding/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/sophia-hair-braiding/book.html

## Services
- Boho knotless braids: Knotless braids with soft curly pieces left loose, light on the scalp and full of movement.
- Box braids: Classic box braids with clean, even parts, done neat and lightweight.
- Feed-in cornrows: Feed-in and stitch cornrows laid neat from the hairline back.
- Miracle knots: Miracle knots, even at the last minute. Sophia checks you love it after the first braid.
- Silk press & sew-ins: Sleek silk presses and sew-ins, finished with side parts and soft bangs.
- Braids for kids: Moms bring their daughters too. Patient, light-handed braiding so little heads aren't sore.

## About
Sophia braids out of her studio at 2201 Montopolis Dr in southeast Austin, one client at a time, every day of the week from 8 in the morning to 6 at night. Her clients come back for the same reasons: she takes her time, she pays close attention to detail, and she's light-handed, so braids come out neat and lightweight without a sore, tight head. She checks in after the first braid to make sure you love the style, and she braids for moms and their daughters too.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Sophia Hair Braiding is open every day, Monday to Sunday, 8 AM to 6 PM.
- Q: Where is the studio?
  A: 2201 Montopolis Dr, Austin, TX 78741, in Montopolis in southeast Austin, close to Riverside and the airport.
- Q: Can I get braids at the last minute?
  A: Call (737) 232-0234. Sophia has fit in last-minute miracle knots before, so it's always worth asking.
- Q: Will my head be sore after?
  A: Clients say Sophia is light-handed: braids come out neat and comfortable, not tight.
- Q: Do you braid kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Moms bring their daughters, and Sophia takes the same care with little heads.
- Q: How much do braids cost?
  A: It depends on the style, size and length. Call (737) 232-0234 with the style you want and Sophia will let you know.
